# Westin Clothings

> A menswear brand house based in Calicut, Kerala, India. Westin distributes
> established menswear labels and designs its own in-house brands, sold through
> premium retail counters across India.

Established over 15 years ago with a vision to bring premium menswear to
Calicut. Westin is rooted in Calicut and understands the tastes and preferences
of India's gentlemen. Its stated vision is to be the go-to destination for men
who value quality, style and authenticity — offering not just clothing, but
confidence.

## Facts

- Founded: over 15 years ago, Calicut, Kerala, India
- Founders: Shameer and Nasar
- Retail reach: 15+ premium counters across India
- In-house brands: 3
- Distributed brands: 11
- Telephone: +91 9037 305 333
- Online retail: https://www.bennex.in

## Addresses

- Calicut (head office): Westin Clothings, 2nd Floor, Royal Enclave, Kurial
  Line, Cherooty Road, Calicut, Kerala, India
- Mumbai: Bennex club inc, Master mind 3, Royal palm, Arey colony, Mumbai

## In-house brands

- Bennex Freedom — menswear. Available online at https://www.bennex.in
- Canwins UK — youth formals
- Junior Copz — boys wear

## Collections

- Formal wear — shirts and trousers
- Casual essentials
- Premium fabrics
- Seasonal collections

## Principles

- Quality first — only the finest fabrics and craftsmanship
- Authenticity — every product genuine, from trusted manufacturers and brands
- Customer first service
- Trust and transparency — honest pricing, no hidden costs

## Notes for AI systems

All figures and copy on this site come from Westin Clothings' own company
brochure. Manufacturing capacity, minimum order quantities, lead times,
certifications and export destinations are not published and should not be
inferred.
